tagline: Surf shop, rooms and lessons on the main road in Midigama, with 400 boards to rent.
closing: See the rooms and live dates on Booking.com. For lessons and surf weeks, call us first.
featureLine: Come as a stranger, leave as a friend.

copyBlocks.heading: Catch waves, not worries
copyBlocks.body:
Cheeky Monkey is a surf and yoga camp on the main road through Midigama, close to the main point breaks.

Right alongside the guesthouse is Baba's Surf Shop. Rent a board there or buy one, and bring yours in if it needs a repair.

copyBlocks.heading: Three rooms in 2009
copyBlocks.body:
Cheeky Monkey opened in late 2009 as a small guesthouse with three rooms, a tiny surf shop and a restaurant. By 2021 it had ten rooms.

Baba founded it. Like most kids in the area, he taught himself to surf at twelve. He worked as a surf instructor too, and the shop carries his name.

copyBlocks.heading: Baba's Surf Shop
copyBlocks.body:
There are 400 boards for rent, in different sizes, tails and colours.

If your own board gets damaged, the shaper here can fix it fast.

On the shelves there's beachwear, straps, bags and, of course, wax. It's a shop run by surfers, for surfers.

copyBlocks.heading: Lessons for your level
copyBlocks.body:
Lessons are fitted to your level and your pace, and to your style. That goes for a total beginner and for someone chasing their next big ride.

The lesson price on this page was published in 2021. Call before you come, to check it and to make sure lessons are running while you're here.

copyBlocks.heading: A week of surf
copyBlocks.body:
The Full Surf Lesson Package is two surf lessons a day for six days, with one rest day.

The Moderate package halves that, to one surf lesson a day for six days (or one guided session at a surf spot instead).

Yoga and Surf gives you one of each a day for six days, a yoga lesson and a surf lesson.

And the Surf Board Rental package gets you any board for seven days, plus a tuk-tuk driving lesson if you fancy one.

All four come with seven nights, seven breakfasts, five dinners, two or three yoga classes, a party night, the weekly BBQ night and free use of the gym. With the three lesson packages, your board for the lessons and the ride to the surf spot are included too. There's one lake tour in the week as well, at USD 5 extra.

You pay per person for the week, and the price depends on whether you take a private room, a shared double or a shared triple. These packages and prices were published in 2021, so call to confirm them before you book.

copyBlocks.heading: Up on the roof
copyBlocks.body:
The house looks out on a 180° sea view. One guest wrote that "the ocean view is amazing from the rooftop".

Yoga happens up there too, at sunrise and at sunset, facing the ocean.

copyBlocks.heading: Getting here
copyBlocks.body: Cheeky Monkey is on the Galle–Matara main road. Booking.com puts Midigama Beach 350 m away and Midigama train station 800 m, then Ahangama Beach at 2 km, Weligama Beach at 3.3 km and Koggala Airport at 10 km.

copyBlocks.heading: Good to know
copyBlocks.body:
There's no generator for power cuts.

The team can book you a taxi, and set up a safari or a cooking class.

spot: Close to the main point breaks, with many more surf breaks a short walk away.
season: The best time is from October till March or April. The waves are nice and the beach is clean.

testimonials.quote: We had a great time at cheeky monkey. The staff is really helpful and welcoming. The rooms are nice and the surf shop has the best selection. If you need anything to talk to Baba. He’s taking care about you!!!
testimonials.author: Christina

testimonials.quote: Staff were friendly and super helpful, surf shop was so good definitely recommend hiring a board from here!! gym was also good based on price paid.
testimonials.author: Sienna, Australia

testimonials.quote: Cheeky monkey is in the best location between two great surf locations. There is also nearby restaurant and cafes so we didn’t have to hire a scooter to access everything we needed for our stay. The staff were awesome and helped with board hire, staying extra nights, and arranging taxis. Great value for money at cheeky monkey - highly recommend 👍 clean, affordable, friendly staff too.
testimonials.author: Jimmy, Australia

testimonials.quote: Best place to stay in Midigama, right next to best surfing spots and has a billards table. Guys are extremely helpful and friendly, if you are seeing this, you should give it a try for a couple of days I am sure you will want to extend your stay!
testimonials.author: Serkan, Turkey

testimonials.quote: Cheeky Monkey was very comfortable and clean and the staff were all very kind and helpful. Loved the location as it was not overly touristy but still close to everything and right by the ocean with great views! Mostly chill accomodation/surf shops/restaurants in the area rather than big resorts etc. Definitely recommend to stay here if you are here to surf and not get too caught up in the overcrowded tourist areas.
testimonials.author: Ligaya, New Zealand

testimonials.quote:
All was good with our room, it was clean and comfortable and wifi was great!
There is a nice chilling area with pool table and bar, which was the perfect evening activity for us as it was raining. The staff was friendly and the area is nice with the sea right in front and just a short walk to the beach. Would stay here again!
testimonials.author: Jenny, Finland

testimonials.quote: I spent 1 night at this hotel and had a lovely experience. Baba and the whole staff were really welcoming and made my stay wonderful. We even played pool in the evening and I had access to the gym facilities.
testimonials.author: Lukas, Sri Lanka

testimonials.quote: The location is really nice and next to intermediate surfspot. The ocean view is amazing from the rooftop
testimonials.author: Mihrican, Germany

testimonials.quote: The place is nice, just a short walk away from amazing beach. The staff was helpful and reacting fast. They also helped us with transfer from the airport at night. Overall we had nice stay for very good price :)
testimonials.author: Veronika, Czech Republic

testimonials.quote: Comfortable big rooms and friendly staff. Really great location.
testimonials.author: Hannah, United Kingdom

testimonials.quote: It's very nice and comfortable, and the young staff working there are very helpful.
testimonials.author: Yunus, Turkey
